message.content: No, I haven't had any chest pain or dizzy spells, at least not at the start. I haven't noticed anything like feeling cold, constipation, hair loss or a hoarse voice. I can't say for sure about weight gain, since my legs are swollen. The main things are that I get very short of breath when I do anything, and my legs are swollen. This started about two weeks after I had a cold or chest infection. The belly pain is hard to place exactly. I'm not sure it's under the right ribs, and I can't describe it more precisely than that.
